body:
Goal: spec §10.3. Separate stream, independent of the docs stack (no edges). One commit per item, each with a regression test under test/ (fixture repos must run offline, commit.gpgsign=false in throwaway repos):
1. agb sweep drops --project: bin/agb.mjs:136 passes { project } to sweepToPlan, so the loss is downstream. Write a failing test first (fake-agy fixture asserting the agy invocation for a sweep-run ticket contains the project), trace through lib/sweep.mjs and the run path to find where it is dropped, then fix.
2. MCP agb_run.concurrency: agb run has no --concurrency flag, so reject it explicitly: if the tool call supplies `concurrency`, return a tool error naming the parameter; remove it from the input schema. Tests: supplied -> error; omitted -> runs. Do not add a CLI flag.
3. MCP serverInfo.version reports 0.7.0 (mcp/server.mjs:155): use the same version source `agb --version` uses in bin/agb.mjs (works bundled and unbundled); test asserts it equals root package.json version.
4. Literal \n: bin/agb.mjs lines 62, 69, 107, 484 at 4864376 use '\\n' inside strings; replace with real newlines (or separate console calls). Test the usage output contains no backslash-n.
5. Probe writer: change `probe-${day}.md` to `probes-${day}.md` (bin/agb.mjs ~350), keeping current write mode. Fix the lib/pools.mjs:69 comment to cite the committed probes file whose numbers match the cited ceilings; if none matches, drop the filename and cite docs/calibration/.
6. Probe default dir: AGB_CALIBRATION_DIR if set, else `join(process.cwd(), 'docs', 'calibration')`; update the comment at bin/agb.mjs:344 and the probe help desc to say so. Test both.
7. AGB_ALLOW_DIRTY text (lib/scheduler.mjs:1384-1391): merges and gate rollbacks run in the integration/ticket worktrees and the base advances by CAS update-ref, so the main checkout is not reset. Verify that at your base (grep `reset', '--hard'` targets); if confirmed, rewrite both the error (1386) and warning (1390) to say uncommitted changes are left untouched but are not part of the run's base, and test the text. If you find a reset of the main checkout, leave the text, document it, and record the item as no-change.
8. test/security.test.mjs:152 title says "on darwin" but runs wherever gateSandboxEnabled() is true: rename to "...outside the worktree when the gate sandbox is available". Only that title.
9. Stray undefined/ dir: search with `git log --all --oneline -- undefined`, grep for path joins on possibly-undefined values in lib/ bin/ test/, run `npm test` in a fresh clone and check `git status --porcelain` for undefined/. If not reproduced, record the commands and output in the PR description; no commit for this item.

Commits: one per item that changes code (its regression test in the same commit), then one final commit with npm run build output (dist/) and CHANGELOG. CHANGELOG bullets for user-visible items 1-7 only (those with code changes). hollow-test: kill survivors only in lines this ticket changed; list others in the PR without fixing. If website/ lands on main before you open the PR, rebase and do the website steps below; otherwise skip them.

After source edits: npm run build, commit dist/, then git status --porcelain dist/ vendor/ must be empty. If website/ exists on your base: cd website && npm run gen, commit website/generated/, and remove or rewrite every "Known issue (T-CODE-FIXES-AUDIT item N)" callout in website/content for each fixed item (node website/scripts/check-known-issues.mjs must pass). Add one CHANGELOG.md Unreleased bullet per user-visible fix. lib/lock.mjs and lib/gates.mjs are rails: do not edit them.

Context: repo antigravity-booster (agb), plugin v1.0.0. Spec: .adlc/specs/docs-site.md (revision 3: Vercel hosting, default Next.js server output) — read it first; section references below point into it. Use Node >= 22.19.0. Work on a branch off origin/main; never push to or merge into main (merge is the owner's decision).

Hard constraints: never modify .adlc/config.json (including acknowledgedNewRailBypass / trustedCodeownersAttested), lib/lock.mjs, lib/gates.mjs or CODEOWNERS (these are this ticket's rails). 

Operational notes:
- Run commands from the repo root; lines beginning `cd website &&` run in a subshell, e.g. `(cd website && npm ci)`.
- `npm test` is the required gate. `unshare -r -n npm test` is informational: run it if user namespaces are available and paste the output; if unsupported, say so. `cd website && npm ci` needs network and is not run under unshare.
- AC30 `gate-manifest record` writes .adlc/manifest.jsonl, which is untracked at 4864376: do not commit it; paste the `verify` output. If record fails for environmental reasons (e.g. missing ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY), paste the error; it is an audit gate and does not block the PR (AGENTS.md degrade rule).
- The follow-up chore PR touches only .adlc/tickets/ and .adlc/ticket-archive/ (ticket complete/archive); it is not part of this ticket's scope.

Verification (run each, show output in the PR description):
- npm test (root suite passes; spec AC1, also try: unshare -r -n npm test)
- git diff --quiet origin/main -- .adlc/config.json; echo $?   -> 0 (AC29)
- npx adlc rails-guard --base origin/main --rails lib/lock.mjs --rails lib/gates.mjs --rails .adlc/config.json --rails CODEOWNERS; echo $?   -> 0 (AC22)
- npm test && npx adlc gate-manifest record tests --ticket T-CODE-FIXES-AUDIT && npx adlc gate-manifest verify; echo $?   -> 0 (AC30)

- npx adlc hollow-test --test-cmd "npm test" --base origin/main   -> kill survivors (maxBuffer off-by-one mutants are an accepted equivalent class)
- npm run build && git status --porcelain dist/ vendor/   -> empty after commit
- if website/ exists: node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check && node website/scripts/check-known-issues.mjs; echo $?   -> 0

Finish: open a PR (not merged by you). After merge, in a follow-up chore PR, run npx adlc ticket complete T-CODE-FIXES-AUDIT --write --authorize then npx adlc ticket archive T-CODE-FIXES-AUDIT --write --authorize (AC31). Archive this ticket after merge.
title: Fix the nine code defects found by the 2026-10-09 docs audit
